title: The Characteristic-Three Degeneration
statement: Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic 3, the map is surjective while remaining étale and noninjective.

members.title: Characteristic-three degeneration
members.statement: In characteristic 3, the translation T=b+S puts the fiber cubic into the form cS^3+S^2+W; the missed curve is empty and the triple-root stratum disappears.

members.title: Surjectivity in algebraically closed characteristic three
members.statement: Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic 3, the map is surjective while remaining étale and noninjective.
